audit.whatIsWrong: Both level charts are effectively inverted against the prose that sits beside them. Content win[0..6] reads Gangplank/Skill/Shen/Shen/Gangplank/Shen/Shen and the full-layer phases repeat it, but whys[0] says the opening is 'genuinely even', whys[1] says Shen wins the level-2 stand-up trade, whys[2] and whys[3] say levels 3-5 'tilt to you', and whys[5] and whys[6] say you 'own the late game outright'. The packet chart (Skill/Shen/Gangplank/Gangplank/Skill/Gangplank/Gangplank) agrees with the prose, not with the chart.
audit.why: Shen's only winning stage is the early empowered-auto trade; from the moment a keg is placed, Parrrley-detonation poke bypasses Spirit's Refuge and a tank Shen has no burst to answer it.
audit.corrected: Both charts set to Skill/Shen/Gangplank/Gangplank/Skill/Gangplank/Gangplank with ratings to match.

audit.why: Spikes name the right windows: Shen's levels 1-3 Twilight Assault trade, Gangplank's level 4-6 keg poke, the Sheen/Stand United crossover, and the late chained-keg peak. Four entries present.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer names only Shadow Dash and describes it as 'His engage CC. Dodge it.' with no range, no cooldown, and no mention of the interaction that actually decides the lane: Spirit's Refuge blocks basic attacks only, so it does nothing against a Parrrley-detonated keg. Twilight Assault and Stand United are never named in the full layer at all.
audit.why: Riot text, Spirit's Refuge (W): 'Attacks that would hit Shen or his allies near his spirit blade are blocked' — attacks, 16/14.5/13/11.5/10, 400 range. Shadow Dash (E) is a 600-range taunting dash on 18/16/14/12/10 costing 150 energy. Twilight Assault (Q) is 8/7.25/6.5/5.75/5. Stand United (R) is 200/180/160 and a channel.
audit.corrected: Shadow Dash given its range and cooldown; the Spirit's Refuge / Q-detonation interaction written into the full layer where the content layer already has it right.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldown section has no numbers; packet counts only one sequencing cue.
audit.why: Shadow Dash at 18s rank 1 falling to 10s at rank 5 is the window that governs every commit.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and report[9].t.
